evidence.dominant_driver: The 25bp hike was heavily priced; the hawkish residual is the unanimous vote plus 12/18 officials projecting one more hike this year, while Warsh's press conference remains the dominant unresolved catalyst.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: The hike itself was ~93% priced; the path and Warsh framing were the real surprise channels.

surprise.actual: 25bp hike to 3.75%-4.00%; unanimous 12-0; 12/18 see one more 25bp hike in 2026
surprise.consensus: 25bp hike; market focused on whether 2026 dot implied one additional hike

absorption.reason: The 25bp hike was overwhelmingly priced. Only the future path carries meaningful residual information; 27 minutes have elapsed and Warsh has not yet spoken.

observed_reaction.note: Reliable synchronized post-release prices were not available before decision; no later information used.

observations.gold: ~4350 pre-event and strongly higher on day
observations.interpretation: Pre-event rates/oil easing and risk-on tone conflict with a simple hawkish selloff; press conference can flip direction.

evidence.decision_notes: Forecast made 27 minutes after the statement and before the 2:30pm ET press conference. It targets residual move from now, not the initial FOMC candle. Leakage-safe M2 learning used only ACTIONABLE segments; it supports neutral/MIXED treatment at 4h/next-session, while directional 5-6 segments remain only EARLY_SIGNAL.
